title: Lemon prawns with asparagus
summary: Lemon prawns with asparagus is a italian dinner built around raw king prawns and asparagus, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat raw king prawns dry and season it. Prep asparagus and garlic for Lemon prawns with asparagus so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook raw king prawns on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook asparagus and garlic in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Lemon prawns with asparagus before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice raw king prawns and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
